app.intro: This computer can serve AI requests for your SplitCortex pool, like a phone running the node app. Closing the window keeps the node running in the system tray.
app.title: App
app.upToDate: The app is up to date.
app.updateFailed: Could not check for or install the update. Try again later.
app.startAtLogin: Start when I log in (hidden in the tray)

join.title: Join a pool
join.intro: Open the pool in the SplitCortex web app, choose Add device, and type the code it shows here.

errors.invalidCode: This code is not valid, has expired or was already used. Create a new one in the web app.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.conflict: This computer is already registered. Remove the old device in the web app, or leave the pool here first.
errors.untrustedServer: The server could not prove that it knows the code. Nothing was sent. Check the address.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.server: The server answered with an error. Try again.
errors.invalidUrl: Enter a full address such as https://app.example.com/api.

join.urlHint: The address of your SplitCortex web app followed by /api.

node.title: This computer
node.leaveBody: This computer forgets its identity and deletes the stored model. Remove the device in the web app as well, then join again with a new code to use it again.
node.notApproved: Waiting for an admin to approve this device in the web app.
node.noGateway: The platform has not given this device a gateway yet.
node.modelFailed: The model could not be loaded: {{error}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.computeHint: Automatic measures CPU and GPU once per model and takes the faster. An admin's setting in the web app wins.
settings.contextHint: {{min}} to {{max}}; empty is automatic. The model reloads when it changes.
settings.contextInvalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} or leave empty.
settings.connectOnStart: Connect and load the model when the app opens
settings.keepAwake: Keep the computer awake while serving

logs.title: Logs
logs.empty: Nothing yet. Logs show states and counts, never prompts or answers.
